title: Midday Sunwatch
text:
🌤️ Midday Sunwatch — November 04, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B5.7)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B9.7 (Peaked November 04, 2026 at 15:00 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 410 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Unsettled (Kp 3.00)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

Satellite conditions are a little spicy right now! 🛰⚡💡🌌

A broad coronal-hole-like region and several bright active regions stand out in today’s solar images, while sunspots remain relatively small.

Images: NASA SDO/AIA — 193, 335, 171, 304, 131, 94 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
